```{r SoundOut_factor_analysis}
ability_vars <- c("mpt","mdt","cabat")
n <- nrow(dat)

if(is.null(dat$mus_ability)){
  dat <- compute_fscores(data = dat, indicator_vars = final_ability_vars, var_name = "mus_ability", check_ordinal = F, missing = "pairwise")
  saveRDS(dat, file="../data/dat_replication_soundout_filtered.rds")
  } 
```

```{r SoundOut_cohens_d}
source("../analysis/maha_v8c.R")

c_dat <- dat[!is.na(dat$gender),]
c_dat <- c_dat[!is.na(c_dat$mpt),]
c_dat <- c_dat[!is.na(c_dat$mdt),]
c_dat <- c_dat[!is.na(c_dat$cabat),]
c_dat$gender <- as.factor(c_dat$gender)
c_dat$gender <- droplevels(c_dat$gender)
c_dat_us <- c_dat[c_dat$country == "United States" & !is.na(c_dat$country),] 
c_dat_uk <- c_dat[c_dat$country == "United Kingdom" & !is.na(c_dat$country),] 
vars <- c("mpt","mdt","cabat","mus_ability")

if(file.exists("../results/effectsizes_replication_us.RData")){
  load("../results/effectsizes_replication_us.RData")
  } else{
    cohens_ds <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) effectsize::cohens_d(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_us, pooled_sd = F, verbose = F) %>% broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9,13),3]
    overlap <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) p_overlap(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_us, parametric = F, verbose = F) %>% broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9, 13),3]
    prob_superior <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) p_superiority(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_us, parametric = T, verbose = F) %>% broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9, 13),3] 
    eta_sq <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) etasq(lm(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_us)) %>% broom::tidy())[,3]
    r2 <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) summary(lm(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_us))$r.squared %>% broom::tidy())
    bfs <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) extractBF(ttestBF(formula = as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_us))[1]) 
    effectsizes_us <- data.frame(DV = vars, cohens_d = cohens_ds$mean, pct_overlap = overlap$mean, prob_superior = prob_superior$mean, eta_sq = eta_sq$mean, R2 = r2$x, BayesFactor = bfs$bf)
    
  c_dat_m <- c_dat_us[c_dat_us$gender == "Male", c("mpt","mdt","cabat", "mus_ability")]
  c_dat_f <- c_dat_us[c_dat_us$gender == "Female", c("mpt","mdt","cabat", "mus_ability")]
  mv_es <- maha(c_dat_f, c_dat_m)
  mv_esq <- etasq(lm(cbind(mpt, mdt, cabat) ~ gender, data = c_dat_us))
  effectsizes_us <- rbind(effectsizes_us, c("multivariate", mv_es$D, mv_es$OVL, mv_es$CL, mv_esq["gender",1], NA))
  #save(effectsizes_us, file = "../results/effectsizes_replication_us.RData")
  saveRDS(effectsizes_us, here('results', 'effectsizes_replication_us.rds'))
  }

if(file.exists("../results/effectsizes_replication_uk.RData")){
  load("../results/effectsizes_replication_uk.RData")
  } else{
    cohens_ds <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) effectsize::cohens_d(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_uk, pooled_sd = F, verbose = F) %>% broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9, 13),3]
    overlap <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) p_overlap(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_uk, parametric = F, verbose = F) %>% broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9, 13),3]
    prob_superior <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) p_superiority(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_uk, parametric = T, verbose = F) %>% broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9, 13),3] 
    eta_sq <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) etasq(lm(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_uk)) %>% broom::tidy())[,3]
    r2 <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) summary(lm(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_uk))$r.squared %>% broom::tidy())
    bfs <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) extractBF(ttestBF(formula = as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), data = c_dat_uk))[1]) 
    effectsizes_uk <- data.frame(DV = vars, cohens_d = cohens_ds$mean, pct_overlap = overlap$mean, prob_superior = prob_superior$mean, eta_sq = eta_sq$mean, R2 = r2$x, BayesFactor = bfs$bf)
    
  c_dat_m <- c_dat_uk[c_dat_uk$gender == "Male", c("mpt","mdt","cabat", "mus_ability")]
  c_dat_f <- c_dat_uk[c_dat_uk$gender == "Female", c("mpt","mdt","cabat", "mus_ability")]
  mv_es <- maha(c_dat_f, c_dat_m)
  mv_esq <- etasq(lm(cbind(mpt, mdt, cabat) ~ gender, data = c_dat_uk))
  effectsizes_uk <- rbind(effectsizes_uk, c("multivariate", mv_es$D, mv_es$OVL, mv_es$CL, mv_esq["gender",1], NA))
  saveRDS(effectsizes_uk, here('results', 'effectsizes_replication_uk.rds'))
  }

effectsizes_us <- effectsizes_us %>%
  mutate(across(c("cohens_d", "pct_overlap", "prob_superior", "eta_sq", "R2", "BayesFactor"), ~as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(cohens_d, pct_overlap, prob_superior, eta_sq, R2, BayesFactor), ~round(., digits = 3))) %>%
  mutate(country = "US")

effectsizes_uk <- effectsizes_uk %>%
  mutate(across(c("cohens_d", "pct_overlap", "prob_superior", "eta_sq", "R2", "BayesFactor"), ~as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(cohens_d, pct_overlap, prob_superior, eta_sq, R2, BayesFactor), ~round(., digits = 3))) %>%
  mutate(country = "UK")

```

```{r TML_cohens_d}
source("../analysis/maha_v8c.R")

dat_replication_tml$gender <- as.factor(dat_replication_tml$gender)
dat_replication_tml$gender <- droplevels(dat_replication_tml$gender)
vars <- c("mpt","mdt","cabat","mus_ability")

if(file.exists("../results/effectsizes_replication_tml.RData")){
  load("../results/effectsizes_replication_tml.RData")
  } else{
    cohens_ds <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) effectsize::cohens_d(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), 
                                                    data = dat_replication_tml, 
                                                    pooled_sd = F, verbose = F) %>%
                           broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9,13),3]
    overlap <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) p_overlap(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), 
                                                   data = dat_replication_tml, 
                                                   parametric = F, verbose = F) %>% 
                         broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9, 13),3]
    prob_superior <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) p_superiority(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), 
                                                             data = dat_replication_tml, 
                                                             parametric = T, verbose = F) %>%
                               broom::tidy())[c(1,5,9, 13),3] 
    eta_sq <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) etasq(lm(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), 
                                                 data = dat_replication_tml)) %>% 
                        broom::tidy())[,3]
    r2 <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) summary(lm(as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)), 
                                               data = dat_replication_tml))$r.squared %>% 
                    broom::tidy())
    bfs <- map_dfr(vars, function(v) extractBF(ttestBF(formula = as.formula(sprintf(" %s ~ gender", v)),
                                                       data = dat_replication_tml))[1]) 
    effectsizes_tml_rep <- data.frame(DV = vars, cohens_d = cohens_ds$mean, pct_overlap = overlap$mean,
                                  prob_superior = prob_superior$mean, eta_sq = eta_sq$mean, R2 = r2$x,
                                  BayesFactor = bfs$bf)
    
  c_dat_m <- dat_replication_tml[dat_replication_tml$gender == "Male", c("mpt","mdt","cabat", "mus_ability")]
  c_dat_f <- dat_replication_tml[dat_replication_tml$gender == "Female", c("mpt","mdt","cabat", "mus_ability")]
  mv_es <- maha(c_dat_f, c_dat_m)
  mv_esq <- etasq(lm(cbind(mpt, mdt, cabat) ~ gender, data = dat_replication_tml))
  effectsizes_tml_rep <- rbind(effectsizes_tml_rep, c("multivariate", mv_es$D, mv_es$OVL, mv_es$CL, mv_esq["gender",1], NA))
  saveRDS(effectsizes_tml_rep, file = "../results/effectsizes_replication_tml.rds")
  }

effectsizes_tml_rep <- effectsizes_tml_rep %>%
  mutate(across(c("cohens_d", "pct_overlap", "prob_superior", "eta_sq", "R2", "BayesFactor"), ~as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(BayesFactor = formatC(BayesFactor, format = "e", digits = 2)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(cohens_d, pct_overlap, prob_superior, eta_sq, R2), ~round(., digits = 3)))

```
